verdict.rationale: AWS explicitly documents that the CLI/API provides functionality equivalent to the browser-based Management Console (aws-docs-42), backed by comprehensive IAM, CDK, CloudFormation, Cost Explorer, and Budgets APIs that mirror console capabilities, plus an official CLI and MCP servers for programmatic/agentic access (aws-docs-1, aws-docs-50, aws-probe-4, aws-probe-5). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification confirming true 1:1 parity for every niche console feature, and no explicit public API spec (OpenAPI) was found (aws-probe-3).
